notes: Matches its sister app Arcadia (Dusk and Cloud looks, a Start checklist, Arcadia in Add-ons). Adds Nexus Launcher for Xbox and Game Pass PC games. Quick install for Inno Setup, NSIS and MSI installers, and .zip/.7z/.rar/.iso archives are unpacked for you. Downloads resume and retry, never keep a short file, check disk space first and show speed and time left. Installer errors are explained in plain words.
